core_tool_catalog: reseam tools list/describe supplies the actual core JSON CLI catalog; these four helpers are separate orchestration commands

commands.name: rebuild
commands.purpose: 逐部件重展开、保留失败并回退父状态
commands.acceptance: provisional UV only; requires global pack, rebake and actual appearance review

commands.name: preview
commands.purpose: 先冻结目标和看图，再烘焙小样与独立回读
commands.acceptance: target_review required before bake; diagnostic GLB is not final visual or PBR acceptance

commands.name: collect
commands.purpose: 具名多对象GLB、贴图和评审交付核验
commands.acceptance: retain actual reviewer and numeric/material scope; verify geometry, UV, texture and complete part coverage

commands.name: report
commands.purpose: 历史与baseline的实际颜色、贴图、棋盘格和UV对比
commands.acceptance: read-only evidence composition; render_missing is explicit; failures and different geometry/protocol groups remain visible
